name: tengu-monorepo
description: Tengu — AI Autonomous Penetration Testing Platform rebuilt on a Pi core

scripts.build:pi: cd packages/telemetry && npm run build && cd ../schema && npm run build && cd ../chord && npm run build && cd ../tui && npm run build && cd ../codemode && npm run build && cd ../mcp && npm run build && cd ../ai && npm run build:offline && cd ../durable && npm run build && cd ../env && npm run build && cd ../agent && npm run build && cd ../coding-agent && npm run build
scripts.build:tengu: npm run build --workspace=@tengu/store && npm run build --workspace=@tengu/intercept && npm run build --workspace=@tengu/ops && npm run build --workspace=@tengu/engine && npm run build --workspace=@tengu/cli
scripts.build: npm run build:pi && npm run build:tengu
scripts.test:tengu: node --test packages/tengu-store/test/*.test.ts packages/tengu-intercept/test/*.test.ts packages/tengu-ops/test/*.test.ts packages/tengu-engine/test/*.test.ts packages/tengu-cli/test/*.test.ts
scripts.test:unit: node --test packages/tengu-store/test/store.test.ts packages/tengu-intercept/test/intercept.test.ts packages/tengu-ops/test/ops.test.ts packages/tengu-engine/test/engine.test.ts packages/tengu-cli/test/cli.test.ts packages/tengu-cli/test/console.test.ts
scripts.test:all: rm -f packages/tengu-*/tsconfig.build.tsbuildinfo && npm run build:tengu && chmod +x packages/tengu-cli/dist/cli.js && npm run test:unit && npm run test:negative && npm run test:property && npm run test:smoke && npm run test:seance
